d:
A major bank fraud case has surfaced in Greater Noida involving Punjab National Bank (PNB).
Several customers allegedly found their Fixed Deposits (FDs) missing from their accounts.
PNB has suspended five employees in connection with the alleged irregularities.
The case has raised serious questions over how the FDs were allegedly broken and funds transferred. The investigation will determine the extent of the alleged fraud and responsibility of those involved.
